messages:
Kevin (Sales): Hey team — strategic solution partner in APAC is asking for a special partner discount band to land a joint POC. asking for 35% off hosted + dedicated on a 12mo commit. can we greenlight? :thinking:
Emma (Partner Ops): Who's the partner tier and expected committed ARR? 35% is higher than standard for channel deals.
Kevin (Sales): Partner is Tier B -> working towards Tier A. Expected commit is ~$150k ARR (projected first-year). POC budget is ~$25k.
Alex (Finance): For $150k commit we typically tier to 20–25% partner margin. 35% would push us below target unit economics unless there's MDF/co-sell credit. any co-funding?
Emma (Partner Ops): They offered a joint case study and co-marketing budget of $10k, but no MDF commit beyond that.
Josh (SE): POC ask: private deployment in their VPC for data residency. SE work is non-trivial — need access, test dataset, and THP for 2 weeks. that'll be additional services ($6–8k).
Sophie (Security): If it's VPC/on-prem we need to push through the partner security questionnaire and get SOC2 attestation proof. timeline ~7–10 days. partner needs to complete questionnaire before infra access.
Kevin (Sales): Noted. The partner says the POC timeline is tight — wants go/no-go within 10 business days.
Alex (Finance): Quick options: (1) Approve 30% discount for 12mo commit + require $20k service/implementation fee; (2) Approve 25% discount and add $10k professional services + $10k co-marketing; (3) Deny exception; ask partner to meet standard channel rate.
Emma (Partner Ops): I prefer option 2. preserves margin and funds SE work. Also recommend a 30-day clawback if they churn under commit.
Josh (SE): I can scope the POC work and sign off on the $10k services if we agree. will send a short SOW.
Sophie (Security): I'll send the partner security checklist link and flag the deal as "requires security review" in the portal. Partner must upload evidence (SOC2 + encryption config).
DeployBot: Deal Desk form submitted by Kevin — https://redwood.internal/deals/1776543210 (status: pending review).
Kevin (Sales): I'm happy to route option 2 to Deal Desk. tagging @Alex for approval and @Emma for partner ops sign-off. :pray:
Alex (Finance): I approve option 2 conditionally — finance sign-off provided partner accepts 25% discount + $10k services + $10k co-marketing AND agrees to 30-day clawback on commit.
Emma (Partner Ops): I'll draft the partner amendment and send to partner legal.
Josh (SE): I'll prepare the SOW and share with Kevin + Emma by EOD.
Sophie (Security): I'll start the security review once partner uploads docs. ETA 7 days.
Kevin (Sales): Great, proceeding to partner outreach. thanks all. :thumbsup:
